info.title: Fabula manager API
info.description:
Management of fabulas: scenario versions, tags, running processes, migrations between
versions and their conflict resolution. Every mutation takes a caller-chosen
`request_id`; repeating it is harmless. The actor comes from the authentication of the
transport; each operation names the permission it needs in `x-permission`. Errors are
RFC 7807 problems with a stable `code`.

tags.name: scenarios
tags.description: Scenarios, validation, publication and diffs of versions.

tags.name: catalogs
tags.description: Capabilities and event types a scenario may use.

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags route new starts to versions: move, roll back, split for A/B experiments.

tags.name: fabulas
tags.description: Start, find and inspect fabulas; intervene.

tags.name: migrations
tags.description: Move running fabulas to another version: analysis, clusters, decisions, application.

tags.name: agentic-resolutions
tags.description: Tasks through which trusted agents resolve migration conflicts.

tags.name: audit
tags.description: Who did what, when and why.

AgenticResolutionTask.description: A group of blocked migration items handed to an agent (one cluster per task).
AgenticResolutionTask.title: AgenticResolutionTask

Assignment.description: How a start was routed. Recorded in the fabula's labels and in the index.
Assignment.title: Assignment

CampaignSource.description:
Which fabulas the campaign considers. Empty `versions` means every version but
the target; `statuses` defaults to every status that can still move.
CampaignSource.title: CampaignSource

Cluster.description: Items of one source version whose analysis looks the same.
Cluster.title: Cluster

ControlFabula.description: An intervention. Version swaps go through migration campaigns instead.
ControlFabula.title: ControlFabula

ControlOutcome.description: What happened to a control request, recorded from the fabula's journal.
ControlOutcome.title: ControlOutcome

Event.description: Neutral CloudEvents-like envelope. Extension attributes live in `attributes`.
Event.title: Event

FabulaRecord.description:
Read model of one fabula, projected from its journal. May lag the state; the
`runtime` stays authoritative for decisions.
FabulaRecord.title: FabulaRecord

ItemTarget.description: Items a decision applies to: the union of the given clusters, ids and verdicts.
ItemTarget.title: ItemTarget

ProblemDetails.description:
RFC 7807 problem. `code` is the stable machine-readable reason; other members
(diagnostics, dry_run, errors...) depend on the code.
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

ProposedResolution.description: An answer to a resolution task. `fabula_ids` narrows it to part of the task.
ProposedResolution.title: ProposedResolution

PublishVersion.description: Publish the YAML or JSON document. Its header names the scenario and the version.
PublishVersion.title: PublishVersion

ResolutionBrief.description: Everything an agent needs to propose a resolution, and nothing it may not see.
ResolutionBrief.title: ResolutionBrief

ResolutionPolicy.description:
Set per scenario; a migration campaign may override it.

* `manual` — only people decide; delegating to an agent is refused.
* `agent_proposes` — an agent proposes, a person approves.
* `agent_applies` — a proposal that passes the dry run and every limit below is
  applied without a person.
ResolutionPolicy.title: ResolutionPolicy

RetryDefaults.description: Transparent retries the executor recommends for its capability.
RetryDefaults.title: RetryDefaults

RollbackTag.description: Point the tag back to an earlier revision's allocation or to a version.
RollbackTag.title: RollbackTag

ScenarioInfo.description: A business process: its identity, owners and the policy for migration conflicts.
ScenarioInfo.title: ScenarioInfo

ScenarioSnapshot.description:
A validated scenario version with the catalog descriptors it was published against.

The core never looks at catalogs: running fabulas keep the descriptors they started
with, so catalog changes do not alter their behaviour or their replay.
ScenarioSnapshot.title: ScenarioSnapshot

ScenarioVersion.description: An immutable published version. Only `status` changes (deprecation).
ScenarioVersion.title: ScenarioVersion

Selector.description: Which version to start: through a tag (default `trunk`) or an explicit version.
Selector.title: Selector

SwapReport.description: What `SwapVersion` would do. `applicable` is false when the swap would be rejected.
SwapReport.title: SwapReport

TagChange.description: One entry of the append-only tag history.
TagChange.title: TagChange

Value.description: Wraps an optional JSON value so that `null` stays distinguishable from "not given".
Value.title: Value
